articles.title: Cockroach Janta Party’s Abhijeet Dipke Throws Open Challenge To PM Modi
articles.description:
The controversy over Abhijeet Dipke’s educational credentials has taken a fresh political turn, with the Cockroach Janta Party founder challenging Prime Minister Narendra Modi to publicly display their respective degrees. Dipke said he was ready to show his Boston University degree and suggested that both he and PM Modi make their educational documents public to settle the issue.

His remarks came after questions were raised on social media over his claim of having studied at the US university.

Dipke’s Challenge

In a post on X, Dipke said people had been waiting impatiently to see his degree and questioned why those demanding his credentials had not raised similar questions about PM Modi’s degree.

People are really running out of patience waiting to see my degree.

Makes me wonder how they’ve managed for 12 years without seeing the Prime Minister’s.

Sir @narendramodi, let’s both show our degrees and put an end to this?

— Abhijeet Dipke (@abhijeet_dipke) September 3, 2026

He invited the Prime Minister to show their degrees publicly, arguing that doing so would bring the controversy to an end. This is not the first time Dipke has made such a challenge. He had previously linked questions about his education to the debate surrounding PM Modi’s academic qualifications.

Also Read: SIR Voter Roll Exercise: 13.37 Crore Names Left Out Across 30 States, 5 Top The List

What Sparked The Row?

A social media clip from the podcast circulated claims that an alleged search of Boston University records did not find evidence of Dipke’s graduation. However, the report noted that this remains an allegation and does not by itself establish that his degree claim is false.

Dipke has previously said that he studied at Boston University through a scholarship. His educational background had also faced questions earlier, including from Maharashtra-based RTI activist Amit Tiwari, who questioned how the cost of studying in the US was financed.

Also Read: Telangana CM Revanth Reddy Removes Konda Surekha From Cabinet With Immediate Effect

articles.title: Breaking: ED Report Sparks Punjab Political Storm, High Court to Hear Corruption Case Today
articles.description: Punjab politics has entered a fresh phase of confrontation after an Enforcement Directorate (ED) report submitted before the Punjab and Haryana High Court raised serious allegations of an alleged corruption network linked to government functioning. The 200-page report, highlighted in ABP News’ Operation Punjab, has triggered a political storm, with the Bhagwant Mann government facing intense opposition scrutiny. The report reportedly names Rajveer Ghuman, described as an Officer on Special Duty to Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann, along with Nitin Goyal, who is alleged to have acted as an intermediary between officials and Ghuman. The ED investigation reportedly details 21 transfer and posting-related instances and refers to seven cases connected with arms licences. The allegations also reportedly cover transfers and postings, tenders, change-of-land-use permissions for builders and appointments within the Chief Minister’s Office. According to the reported findings, electronic devices and documents recovered during the investigation allegedly provided information about financial transactions and an organised network. The ED had reportedly conducted searches at locations linked to Goyal in May, during which two bags allegedly containing cash were thrown from a balcony. The agency reportedly seized ₹21 lakh from the bags. The matter reached the Punjab and Haryana High Court after the ED allegedly sought responses from the Punjab government and police on multiple occasions. The court is scheduled to hear the case today, making the proceedings politically significant. Meanwhile, the Shiromani Akali Dal is set to meet Punjab Governor Gulab Chand Kataria under Sukhbir Singh Badal’s leadership. The BJP has also demanded Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann’s resignation and called for an independent investigation. The allegations remain subject to judicial scrutiny and further investigation.
